title: HB1659 (2018 Regular): Public Safety - Rifles and Shotguns - Purchases

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2018RS/bills/hb/hb1659f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader as filed; no vote on record. Bracketed words ('adjacent' and the definition) are deleted from existing law and left out of the quote; the quote shows the law as the bill would leave it.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-204(a)): If a resident of this State is eligible to purchase a rifle or shotgun under the laws of ANOTHER state, the resident may purchase a rifle or shotgun from a federally licensed gun dealer in the OTHER state.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-204(B)): If a resident of ANOTHER state is eligible to purchase a rifle or shotgun under the laws of this State, the resident may purchase a rifle or shotgun from a federally licensed gun dealer in this State.
